notes.title: First hotfix after release
notes.content:
A new update (0.9.5 ) has been released, in this update we have focused on players' feedback and we have fixed prioritized bugs.

Added resource and item reward texts to responses of Kondoa landmark events and negative gameplay events. 
Fixed formatting of broken event response texts for general gameplay events.
Fixed an issue with research tree that removes known crafting recipes. (Infamous crafting bug mentioned in discussions)
Fixed display settings reverting to default on quit.
Fixed a bug where quality settings were not saving and reverted to default.
Fixed input detection issue when closing the in-game escape menu.
Added missing control checks for the first savanna objectives (resource gathering objectives).
Removed most debug texts used for development.
Restricted tutorial levels to only 4 available achievements.
Re-added the "Make a Camp" achievement.
Added lock-state checks for the objective prompt box camera ping pong button.
Increased the speed of camera in objective ping-pong effect.
Resolved texture streaming pool size issue.

In the next update, we are going to fix autosave and save-load issues. Also we're working on reordering tutorial progression and the difficulty of both tutorial levels.

notes.title: The Ancients is OUT NOW (Early Access!)
notes.content:
Gather 'round the campfire, Tribe!

Turn-based prehistoric survival strategy, The Ancients, is OUT NOW IN EARLY ACCESS!

[previewyoutube=WOV-mHjClDA;full][/previewyoutube]

It's been quite the journey getting here -- from our Kickstarter to this exciting Early Access launch (and beyond) -- and we couldn't have done it without your support. Thank you so much for helping us get here; we are touched by the enthusiasm and patience you've shown us throughout the development period.

Although this information can be found on the game's store page, we'd like to take the time to post it here to remind players our plans for early access:

Why Early Access?
“Early access allows us to get a better feel on player feedback, both in terms of balancing, changes to mechanics, or features that would help with the overall quality of life in the game and its campaign and sandbox experiences. With our small team, early access also helps us prioritize certain content in the game and better track down bugs.”

Approximately how long will this game be in Early Access?
“8 - 12 months”

How is the full version planned to differ from the Early Access version?
“We plan to add new research tech, biomes, maps, craftables, resources, and animals. We will also be adding and removing content according to player feedback.”

What is the current state of the Early Access version?
“The game mechanics are complete. Bugs exist and the game is not fully polished. Content is not fully finished. As mentioned, we plan to add new research tech, biomes, maps, craftables, resources, and animals.”

Will the game be priced differently during and after Early Access?
“The game will remain the same price during and after early access. We have no plans to change the price.”

How are you planning on involving the Community in your development process?
“Community feedback is an important part of our development process. We regularly incorporate feedback both from the Steam discussion and our Discord to ensure that players are getting the best possible experience.”

If you have any questions or found a bug (or just want to say hi!), feel free to post them here in the discussions or join our Discord. After all, when you're here, you're tribe!

Thanks again for all the support -- see you in The Ancients!

notes.title: The Ancients Early Access Release Date is Here!!!
notes.content:
Grab your spears, Tribe!

Turn-based prehistoric survival strategy, The Ancients, will be releasing to Early Access June 5!

The Ancients takes the core mechanics of real-time prehistorical survival strategy, Dawn of Man, and brings it to a unique turn-based experience, complete with deep skill tree, diverse wildlife, real Ice Age biomes and increasingly challenging migration routes to keep your survival skills honed.

Check out the trailer here:
[previewyoutube=WOV-mHjClDA;full][/previewyoutube]

Some Highlights:

 A complete tutorial, campaign mode and procedurally generated sandbox mode for infinite replayability are available from Day 1 in the Early Access release
 60+ historically accurate resources & animals to discover, gather & hunt
 75+ research nodes and society paths to boost replayability and diversify your approach to managing your tribe & surviving the harsh Ice Age environments
 Needs management mechanics will be familiar to survival fans 
 Society management mechanics are new and unique to the genre


Quick Facts:

 Early Access Release Date: June 5, 2024
 Developer: Small Turkey-based indie studio GorillaSoftworks
 Publisher: Camlann Games (Underspace, Ascent of Ashes)
 Price: $19.99 (with a 10% launch discount)
 Game Modes: Single Player (Campaign Mode & procedurally generated Sandbox Mode)
 Discord: https://discord.gg/sKsDGCW6nr


See you next month, Tribe!!!

notes.title: New Patch Is Live: 0.8.17
notes.content:
New Patch Is Live: 0.8.17

Hey Tribe,

New patch is out, we've added some content and fixed some existing issues:

• Added new events and also new options to existing ones.
• Research point gaining is rebalanced to provide easier progression.
• Fixed several creature and clan bugs on save system.
• Fixed climate and weather bugs on loading a save file.
• Research and culture tree requirements and effects changed.
• Added option to save and load game on level ends.
• Added AI Clan to the game.
• Added new vegetables, creatures and trees for new maps Ural, India and SinoChina.
• Added storyline objectives to Ural map.
• Made policy sliders work and connected them to events.
• Changed the nodes under 4 sub branches of culture tree and made them work and selectable.

We are progressing and evolving in preparation for Steam NextFest so catch us October 9 - 16. We will have live content, Dev Q&A, and more!

notes.title: Progress as of February 2023
notes.content:
Hello Tribesmen! As you may know, we have had a successful Kickstarter campaign near the end of 2022. We have managed to reach our initial goal and even go above it. We would first like to thank everyone in our community, whether you have pledged or not, for supporting us in our journey.

So, what have we been up to?

We have been working diligently on The Ancients to bring you the best game possible. Our team of developers have been pouring their hearts and souls into making sure that our game meets your expectations. Through our hard work, we are confident that you will be pleased with the end result when The Ancients is fully playable and ready for release.

To be more specific:

 Rivers system has been implemented.
 Africa, Mesopotamia, and Europe maps are ready now!
 Animals and vegetation for the three levels are modeled and added to the game.
 Tribe scenes for Africa, Mesopotamia, and Europe have been designed. 
 Different objectives for the three maps have been designed and implemented.
 More animals and vegetables have been added.
 Craft system updated.
 20+ more events have been added.
 Historical Landmarks for the maps have been added.
 A large number of bug fixes have been implemented.
 The transition between levels and map selection systems have been implemented.
 Some of the Indian subcontinent animals have been modeled and added.



Again, we would like to extend a heartfelt thank you to our community for your continued support. We are incredibly grateful for the outpouring of enthusiasm and positivity that has allowed us to progress and grow. We are looking forward to what comes next and are eager to continue working on The Ancients as we get ready for a 2023 release.

Join our Discord to stay in the loop about future updates!
